facts.text: Etereo sits above a mangrove forest beside white sand beaches in Kanai, on the Riviera Maya.
facts.excerpt: Etéreo floats atop a lush mangrove forest amidst the unspoiled white sand beaches of Kanai

facts.text: Etereo is an oceanfront resort with direct access to a private white-sand beach overlooking the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Etéreo is an oceanfront resort with direct access to a private white-sand beach overlooking the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: Accommodations have floor-to-ceiling windows and large terraces, many with private plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: floor-to-ceiling windows framing the natural landscape. Large terraces, many with private plunge pools

facts.text: Studios feature carved wooden walls by the artist Manuel Felguerez.
facts.excerpt: carved wooden walls by revered artist Manuel Felguérez

facts.text: Etereo has an adults-only pool called Tranquilo and a family pool called Vivo.
facts.excerpt: Etéreo features Tranquilo, an adults-only pool; Vivo, a family pool

facts.text: The SANA spa has a cenote-inspired pool.
facts.excerpt: SANA, Wellbeing by Auberge, offers a cenote-inspired pool

facts.text: Etereo welcomes families and has a Chavitos Kids Club.
facts.excerpt: Etéreo welcomes families with studios and suites, a Chavitos Kids Club, a family pool, beach activities

facts.text: Itzam is the main dining venue, serving elevated, modern Mexican cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Itzam, our main dining venue offering elevated and modern Mexican cuisine

facts.text: Che Che pairs Japanese techniques with Mexican ingredients in an open-air setting.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the pairing of Japanese techniques with Mexican ingredients, Che Che brings a laidback, open-air dining experience to Etéreo.

facts.text: El Changarro serves the daily local catch on the sand at lunch.
facts.excerpt: El Changarro is lively, local, in-the-sand dining. Open for lunch; the menu focuses on the daily local catch

facts.text: Cena de la Abuela is a signature dinner honoring recipes the chefs grew up making in their grandmothers' kitchens.
facts.excerpt: our signature Cena de la Abuela, a dinner experience honoring the recipes our chefs grew up making in their grandmothers' kitchens

facts.text: Etereo was built in 2022 and was the first hotel in the Kanai development.
facts.excerpt: was built in 2022, and was the first hotel within the Kanai development

facts.text: Etereo was designed by the New York studio Meyer Davis.
facts.excerpt: It was designed by New York–based studio Meyer Davis

facts.text: Playa del Carmen, the closest town, is about a 20 minute drive from Etereo.
facts.excerpt: Playa del Carmen is the closest town, about a 20 minute drive away.

facts.text: Buyouts for weddings and company retreats are common at Etereo.
facts.excerpt: Buyouts for weddings and company retreats are common.

facts.text: Etereo has a dedicated biologist and a Green Team that looks after the beach and mangroves.
facts.excerpt: Etéreo has employed a dedicated biologist at the property, and designated an internal Green Team

facts.text: Ramps run throughout the property, including the walkways to the beach and the docks over the water.
facts.excerpt: There are ramps throughout, including the walkways to the beach and the docks over the water.
